mission.goal: Implement the highest-value remaining recording functionality from the comprehensive plan and beads, with meaningful direct-main GitHub commits and no PRs.

published_checkpoints.change: Native bounded recording inventory, exact selected information/range checks, scoped replay URI, canonical observations and 24 contracts; corrected unrelated-import alert fixture ordering.
Operator recordings/replay commands, private exact handoff, protected AVC/HEVC capture with nine source pins and durable outer approval, independent cold inspection and 16 additional contracts.

concurrent_main_changes_preserved: 2f402c29f76874d14a255cb6b85e761902b3af40: shared HEVC replay session admission and six protocol regressions.
aa83e37650f888ea4762274a4046e16b451b7005: multi-scale DFL package recipe v5, native documentation, HEVC contract formatting and existing review-expiry preview fixture correction.
findings: Native historical replay existed but an operator still had to supply a recorder URI. The new ONVIF path performs bounded recording inventory and exact selection before replay.

GetRecordings retention duration and GetRecordingInformation extrema are device assertions. Unknown dates stay unknown; every supplied bound is enforced without clipping and none proves continuous media coverage.
The existing HTTP transport has a closed SOAP action allowlist. The three new read-only actions were explicitly added; source review caught this integration omission before publication.
Live ONVIF handoff lifetime semantics cannot represent GetReplayUri. A distinct private schema retains unknown replay URI lifetime and complete canonical selected information.
Discovery does not grant capture authority. The protected consumer binds actual file identity and the complete native plan into a separate outer approval, which is retained in the durable receipt.

Source-bearing requests use distinct canonical domains and bind nine observation/file identities before deriving the original namespace. Cold verification reconstructs those pins and original source windows without reopening private metadata.
The exact c839 native run passed163 tests and failed10, exposing the HEVC gate and fixtures. Corrections on later commits have not been verified by that predecessor run.

falsifiers: unknown or contradictory bounds are silently clipped
recording or URI canary appears on stdout/stderr
nested child approval authorizes the wrapper
replacement inode with identical bytes preserves approval
changed private canonical bounds are not revalidated
live handoff is admitted as recording replay
any of nine source pins changes without request/namespace change
cold inspection trusts the private file or reconnects to the recorder
receipt loses the actual outer approval

authority.authority_changes: Explicit read-only recorder operations and a separately approved single native capture wrapper. No standing scheduler, search session, configuration write or live fallback.

budgets.inventory: 64 recordings, 32 tracks per recording, 512-byte descriptive text plus existing complete SOAP/XML/HTTP limits; excess refuses rather than truncates.
budgets.information: 64 KiB canonical complete information, four16 KiB hex chunks,139264-byte handoff,262144-byte private file owner.
budgets.network: Four/six maximum HTTP Digest attempts or three/four UsernameToken exchanges for inventory/selection; existing finite deadline, cancellation and work limits.
budgets.native_capture: Existing finite source, work, picture, archive and publication bounds; one attempt, exact SSRC and explicit codec/cadence.
budgets.receipt: Existing64 windows/64 KiB combined companion bounds; direct AVC/HEVC encodings preserved.
